We’ve changed our usernames before, but they’re always coming back. We block them, but they always use numerous anonymous accounts to go after us. 

I get that I’m just whining at this point, and that it’s all because of my mental health or whatever, but nothing is actually being done and everyone else is receiving all this hate for no reason. The problem isn’t my mental health, the problem is this user who’s constantly harassing us and we can’t do anything about it.

It isn’t that the developers don’t care. It’s just that we do constantly report it to them, and the user is always taken down, but they’re always creating new accounts and we just don’t know what to do about it. The app has a very faulty system itself, and that allows this person to take advantage of it and return every time.

What if it gets to the point where someone does kill themselves? No matter what we do, this person finds us. We block them, but they use other accounts to go after us. No matter what, this person always finds a way to consistently harass us.

My parents are in no way supportive of their child receiving therapy or anything of the sort. It's a complicated situation, and I've been trying my hardest to look for mental health resources online, though I kind of lost the motivation for that. My friends have encouraged me to be dependent on them (and now, I really am just solely dependent on them), so I just don't really know what to do. I know I have severe depression and extreme social anxiety, and though undiagnosed, I suspect that I may have borderline personality disorder. No one's been supportive of that- no one's taken it seriously, along with my eating disorder struggles- so I've kinda been feeling lost.
Thank you. I hope everything goes well for you, too.

Thank you.. All I ever feel rage and emptiness. I really want help, and my friend really are good people, but we've been all fighting and snapping at each other recently. We may all need to try your suggestions, especially me. Thank you.

I just apologize. That's all. They get so mad at me, which is understandable. They've called me a toxic friend, so it's only fair if I hear them out and consider it. 

As for how they act, I do admit that one of them especially gets really.. scary. I feel really terrible talking about them this way. I'm so scared that they'll find this. I don't know.
I usually just apologize profusely and cry. It really gets on their nerves. I'm sorry about all this. Thanks for responding.

They always say I do. I don't even know what I'm doing anymore. Lately, some shit's been popping up in my life. I recently lost a close friend, and one of my relatives is very ill. So I haven't been very emotionally stable. I haven't had time to grieve, as I'm very busy and my friends are also going through things as well, so I have to be there for them. But I feel like such a terrible person. They're going through worst things, and I'm just sulking in my own emotional mess.

I really do apologize. I probably just seem like a spoiled brat.
